issues.description: The PersonService::addParent method has a visibility mismatch across artifacts: the template declares addParent as public (students are expected to implement it), the problem statement describes addParent as a service method to be implemented, but the solution implementation marks addParent as private. Tests and the REST controller in the solution call personService.addParent(...), which requires the method to be public. This inconsistency would prevent compilation and/or access to the method from PersonResource and the test code, blocking students or causing confusion about the intended visibility.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility of PersonService::addParent public in the solution (change 'private Person addParent(...)' to 'public Person addParent(...)') so it matches the template, the problem statement expectations, and callers (tests and PersonResource). Alternatively, if the intended design is to keep it non-public, update the template, problem statement, and all callers/tests accordingly to use the correct public API.
